The only issues labeled **pre-v1** are #2690 and #2711. #2711 is blocked on an upstream release we don't control. #2690 — the actual v1 act — is the **irreversible owner-gated publish**: bump to 1.0.0, `cargo publish` nmp-* to crates.io, publish @nmp/* to npm, prove external consumption. Its issue-blocker (#1626) is closed and master CI is green, so the framework is *ready*, but I will **not** autonomously publish 1.0.0 permanently to public registries — that needs your go. [...] **BOTTOM LINE:** There is NO genuine framework code work in these four blocking v1. #2927 is already done (close it). #2864, #2858, #2974 are all post-v1 (feature app / dev tool / non-v1-claimed MLS feature) and should be labeled phase:post-v1 so they stop looking like un-phased p2 blockers against #2690's "zero open p2 besides #1626" bar. Consistent with the owner's steer: an issue existing ≠ it must ship in v1. v1 remains what #2690 says it is — the owner-gated publish act (name → rc rehearsal → 1.0.0 tag → crates.io/npm → external-consumption proof), gated on the public-name decision and #1626, not on any of these four.
